_comments: Former description, kept as the design note: Excluded from every forecast bucket. An explicit row rather than a null so that 'the rep deliberately left this out' is distinguishable from 'nobody has categorized it yet'.

fields.Name: Omitted
fields.Description: Left out of every forecast total on purpose.

_comments: Former description, kept as the design note: In the pipeline but not forecast. The widest of the three cumulative buckets.

fields.Name: Pipeline
fields.Description: In the pipeline but not forecast to close.

_comments: Former description, kept as the design note: Upside. THE FLAGS ARE CUMULATIVE ON PURPOSE: best case also counts in pipeline, so a 'total pipeline' measure needs one flag test rather than a union of categories.

fields.Name: Best Case
fields.Description: Upside. Also counts in the pipeline total.

_comments: Former description, kept as the design note: The rep is standing behind it. Counts in all three buckets, being the narrowest.

fields.Name: Commit
fields.Description: The rep stands behind it. Counts in the commit, best case and pipeline totals.

_comments: Former description, kept as the design note: Already concluded, so it belongs to attainment rather than to the forecast — all three Include flags are 0 and ForecastSnapshot.ClosedAmount is its own bucket. Counting closed business inside 'commit' is the classic way a forecast quietly double-reports the quarter.

fields.Name: Closed
fields.Description: Already closed. Counted in closed totals, not in the forecast.
